# Foreign keys without a leading index, exempted by tests/test_fk_index_guard.py (R04-02).
#
# These are the single-column foreign keys that were unindexed at release 0.4.0. The list
# may only shrink: the guard fails when an entry becomes indexed or its foreign key goes
# away, so remove the line in the same change.
#
# A new foreign key needs an index (an Index in the model's __table_args__ plus an Alembic
# migration that builds it concurrently). Add a line here only with a justification comment,
# for example a small table or a column that is never joined, filtered, or cascaded on.
#
# Format: table.column [@db-only|@model-only]  # optional reason
#   @db-only     the foreign key exists in the migrated schema but the model omits it
#   @model-only  the model declares the foreign key but no migration creates it
# Both tags record model/migration drift found at 0.4.0; fix the drift, then drop the line.
